title.zh: 将北甘马磷省巴苏德市镇的利东、塔巴塔巴、曼蒙托伊、博拉博德、泰桑、希南帕坎、曼利蒙西托、波兰图纳与奥利瓦等聚居点改设为同名描笼涯的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Sitios of Lidong, Taba-Taba, Manmontoy, Borabod, Taisan, Hinampacan, Manlimonsito, Polantuna, and Oliva in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, into Barrios of Said Municipality with the Same Names
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitios of Lidong, Taba-Taba, Manmontoy, Borabod, Taisan, Hinampacan, Manlimonsito, Polantuna, and Oliva in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, into Barrios of Said Municipality with the Same Names
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển các sitio Lidong, Taba-Taba, Manmontoy, Borabod, Taisan, Hinampacan, Manlimonsito, Polantuna và Oliva thuộc thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Basud, tỉnh Camarines Norte, thành các barrio cùng tên
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนแปลงไซโต้ลีดองตาบาตาบาแมนมอนโทยโบราโบดไทซานฮินัมปาคันแมนลิมอนซิโตโปลันตูนาและโอลิวาในเทศบาลบาซุดจังหวัดกาไมรินส์นอร์เตให้เป็นบารังไกย์ที่มีชื่อเดียวกัน
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah situs Lidong, Taba-Taba, Manmontoy, Borabod, Taisan, Hinampacan, Manlimonsito, Polantuna, dan Oliva di Kotamadya Basud, Provinsi Camarines Norte, menjadi kelurahan dengan nama yang sama
title.ms: Akta menukar situ Lidong, Taba-Taba, Manmontoy, Borabod, Taisan, Hinampacan, Manlimonsito, Polantuna dan Oliva di Perbandaran Basud, Wilayah Camarines Norte kepada kampung dengan nama yang sama

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1317_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Lidong, Taba-taba, Manmontoy, Borabod, Taisan, Hinampacan, Manlimonsito, Polantuna, and Oliva in the Municipality of Basud, Province of Camarines Norte, are converted into barrios of said municipality with the same names.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
